source_text: A 2017 study in Nature Ecology & Evolution suggested an evolutionary angle, analyzing Demographic and Health Surveys from five West African countries and finding that, in high-prevalence ethnic groups, cut women had more surviving children by age 40, attributing this to social conformity aiding marriage and resource access. [44]
